contexts.text: The princes of Pharaoh () = primary precepts. Princes, in the Word, = those things which are primary. Illustrated.
Princes = things which are of truth.
He shall beget twelve princes () = the primary precepts of charity.
Kings, and princes, in the Word, = the things which are primary of the Thing of which they are predicated.

Princes = the primary things of truth, which are precepts; hence the (spiritual) Angels are called principalities, because they are in truths. Princes are predicated from the truths which are of charity. (Explained.)
The prince of this world has been judged () = that evils have been cast down into their Hells, so that they cannot do any more harm.
Princes = the primary precepts of truth. References.
The princes of Kedar () = their intelligence. ( = spiritual truths. AC 3268:4.)
Her king and princes among the gentiles () = that truths are immersed in evils.

My lord, thou art a prince of God in our midst () = the Lord as to good and truth Divine with them... A prince of God = the Lord as to the power of truth, or, as to truth; (for) princes = primary truths...
The prince () = the truth Divine which is from the Lord.
Twelve princes of their peoples () = all the primary things of that Spiritual Church.
The prince () = the primary truths a quo.
The princes of the army () = the Lord as to Divine truth. See DFaith 67:2.
A prince () = what is primary of doctrine thence.
Hence the Angels are called principalities; for princes = the primary things of charity and faith. Illustrated.
To contend as a prince () = to conquer in combats; here, in the combats of temptations. See AC 4293.
The prince of the land () = what is primary among the Churches.
In the Most Ancient Church, he was called honoured, who in the Ancient Church was called a prince.
By the prince of Tyre are signified the primary things of the Knowledges of truth and good. ( = those in principles of falsity. AC 4728:6.)
The prince of the guards () = the things which are primary for interpretation. Prince = what is primary. AC 4966, Explained. AC 5084.
The prince (of the prison) () = primary truth. ( = truth governing in a state of temptations). AC 5044.
The reason a prince = primary truth, is that a king = truth itself; hence princes, because they belong to a king, = the primary things of that truth. Illustrated.

The principality upon His shoulder () = that all Divine truth in the Heavens is from the Lord; for the Heavens are distinguished into principalities according to truths from good; and therefore the Angels are called principalities.
Princes = primary falsities. Illustrated.

The Angels reject from themselves the idea of a king and a prince; and, when they apperceive it with man, they transfer it to the Lord, and perceive that which proceeds from the Lord, and that which is of the Lord in Heaven; namely, the Divine truth from His Divine good.
The prince of the butlers, and the prince of the bakers ()... The prince = what is primary; here, in general; for that which is primary is also general...
The prince of the bakers = the Sensuous in general which is subject to the voluntary part. AC 5163.
Princes () = the primary things of truth. References.
Princes over my cattle () = the primary things of scientifics.
Princes () = primary truths. References. AC 6413:4. AC 6524.

They place blessedness in external things; namely, (in being) princes and magnates in Heaven; when yet heavenly blessedness is not to want to dominate... but to want to serve others, and be the least. Illustrated.
Princes of tributes () = falsities which compelled them to serve. Princes, here, in the opposite, = primary falsities.

Who set thee for a man a prince and a judge over us? () = that he had not yet advanced so far into the truths of the Church... A man a prince = one who is in primary truths, thus who is illustrated more than others in the doctrine of truth. This is what is meant by a prince, in the representative Church.
The prince () = those in genuine truths and thence in good.
By princes are signified also the generals under which are all the rest, that is, the primaries; and they are predicated of truth.

Princes = primary things, and are predicated of the truths of faith; but leaders = chief things, and are predicated of the good of love. In the opposite sense, princes are predicated of the falsities of faith; and leaders, of the evils of love. Illustrated.
The princes of the assembly () = the primary truths. AC 8495:4.
Truths thence in successive order, are represented by the princes of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens ().
The princes = truths which are of service.

The princes of thousands = the primary things which are in the first degree under the truth immediately from the Divine. Princes = primary things; here, truths from good, because these princes were under Moses...
The princes of hundreds = the primary things in the second degree.
The princes of fifties = the intermediate primary things. Explained.
The princes of tens = the primary things in the third place. Explained.
Their princes () = the truths of the Church.
A king = the truth of faith of the Church in the complex; princes, = the primary truths. AC 9391:13. AC 9393:3. AC 9404.
Thou shalt not curse a prince in thy people () = that the doctrine of truth is not to be reviled. A prince = the primary truths of the Church.
The princes of Israel = primary truths.
Princes of men () = primary truths of good.
Princes of the sea () = primary scientifics, which are called dogmas.
Trust not in princes (). Princes = primary truths; thus, in the opposite sense, primary falsities.
The prince () = the truth of faith from the good of love...
The prince of this world is the devil; thus all Hell. AC 10655:3.
It was asked whether in (the Second Earth) they live under the commands of princes, or kings...
Aaron and the princes in the assembly () = the chief of those who were in externals without an internal; for Aaron was their head, and the princes were the leaders.
See Judge, A.
The prince of the kings of the earth () = that from the Lord is all truth from good in the Church. AE 29.
(The English clergy) spoke about principality and dominion...
In Daniel, Michael is called the prince; and by prince in the Word is signified a principal truth.
(They had believed that they) would be kings and princes; (and were told). The greater of you will be kings, and the lesser princes. Described.
The prince of a heavenly Society. Described. CL 14, Described.
The dress of the prince. Described.
Garments sent by the prince.
The prince sent one to represent him at the wedding.
We are all... princes of princes, etc.
The prince of the Society (who wore garments of scarlet, etc.) said he was the servant of his Society, because he was of service to it by doing uses. (Continued. See Priest.)
I was conducted to the prince, in whose palace I saw several hundreds assembled, and the prince in their midst.
An Angel who had died in infancy who had been a prince. SE 3548.
The prince of Tyre = the intelligence which is from the Knowledges of truth.
Princesses = principes foeminae () = their goods.
Prince = truth which is inservient.
Prince = primary truths. AE 654:55.
Prince = truth primarily inservient.
The princes of the sea = primary Knowledges. ( = primary scientific truths. AE 359:9.) ( = the Knowledges of truth, and those in them. AE 687:13.)
Princes = primary truths or falsities, which are called the principles of religion.
Princes = things from Own intelligence.
The prince of the army = the Lord as to the Divine Human, because from Him proceed all the truths and goods which make the Church. AE 573:4.
The princes of the earth = the principal truths of the Church. ( = the affections of truth. AE 617:24. AE 650:17.)

As from the Lord are Divine good and Divine truth, He is called The Prince of peace; and it is said of the multiplying of His principality and peace there shall be no end. Principality is said from Divine truth... prince is said of truths; and = a principal truth.
Princes = primary falsities.
Princes = primary truths from which is intelligence.
Princes = those in truths. AE 537:3.
Princes = principal falsities.
Princes = truths from good.
A Saviour and a Prince () = the Lord, who is called a Saviour from the good of love, and a Prince from the truths of faith.
That there is not any truth which is the bead, and thence not any truth of life from the Lord, is signified by, there shall be no more a prince out of the land of Egypt ().

The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are taken away () = that the truths of wisdom and intelligence from spiritual light in the natural man are turned into the falsities of insanity.
Princes = truths from good.
Princes = principal truths.
The Lord is called Messiah from the Divine Human; and Prince from Divine truth.
The prince who shall come () falsity reigning.
The primary truths of the Church in which they are to be instructed, are signified by, princes, the princes of his people with whom they are to be set ().
The princes who digged the well = those who are intelligent from the Lord.
The twelve princes of the tribes = the truths of the Church in the whole complex.
Princes = falsities.
Haughtiness of mind exists in like manner with those of the common people as with those in principality.
